items.title: Astra 6.2 Is Unusable
items.summary:
Astra 6.2 is simply underwhelming and I honestly hate using it. But lets break down why (spoiler: it's not because it's not capable).

Thank you Coderabbit for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/coderabbit

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg
